_comment: Schematic land/water base for the brief theater chart. Per map: 'water' = closed lat/lon polygons flooded as sea (overshoot the chart bounds freely - the panel clips), 'islands' = land polygons drawn back on top. Hand-authored ~deg-scale schematic coast, good for orientation on a chart marked NOT FOR NAVIGATION. A map with no entry renders all-land (unchanged). Adding a map is data-only. EACH WATER RING MUST BE ONE SIMPLE LOOP THAT TRACES REAL SHORELINE: the Persian Gulf ring was once closed with three box corners instead, which swept the whole of Iran into the flood and rendered 68% of the chart as sea - land where the water was and water where the land was. tests/test_theater_chart.py checks every airfield the presets name against these polygons.

persiangulf._note: One ring, traced as a coastline: Qatar's west coast and around the peninsula, east along the UAE to Ras Musandam, back down the Gulf of Oman side past Muscat, out into the Arabian Sea, then home along the Makran and Iranian coasts to the head of the Gulf and down the Saudi shore to close.
